title: A Spotlight console save writes only its own preference keys

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: Every Spotlight console action (publish switch, layout autosave, Look, theme) builds the whole spaces.preferences object from a snapshot read at the start of the request and writes it back. A layout autosave landing beside a publish toggle, or beside any other console that writes preferences (website editor, page builder), can undo the other's change, for example turning a just-published Spotlight back off. The website editor already avoids this with set_space_preferences (SCAN-833) and the launch path with patchSpacePreferences. The same whole-blob pattern is in manage/layout/actions.ts and edit-page/actions.ts (writePreferences); this row covers the Spotlight console first.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
